verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that shows company status in each state, where clicking a state reveals requirements and upcoming deadlines and lets you take action. That covers seeing upcoming filing deadlines. However, nothing in the evidence describes a consolidated calendar view or reminders/notifications sent before each deadline; the registered-agent copy only offers vague reassurance about staying compliant. Missing for 10: a documented unified compliance calendar view, proactive deadline reminders or alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the deadline-tracking feature.
